Download **bambu-deck-0.1.5.streamDeckPlugin** and double-click it; Stream Deck installs the plugin along with its profiles.

- New key "Steuern": one press puts every control of the printer across the whole deck: pause, stop (hold), light, speed, preheat presets, cool down, fans, home, Z ±10, unload and load for every spool in the AMS. Whatever the printer lacks is left out; small decks page through with "Weiter", "Fertig" goes back
- Every starter profile has the "Steuern" key, so all controls are there without dragging keys in
- Grey keys no longer flash a warning triangle when pressed; the triangle now only means the printer refused
- Job info shows "kein Druck" instead of "fertig um · bereit" when nothing is printing
- The chamber temperature key is labelled "Kammertemp." with a thermometer
